notes.title: Controller settings explained...
notes.content:
Hi Guys!

There has been some talk recently on the forums in regards to the controller settings, with a little bit of confusion around what they do.

I decided to do a little write up here and explain some of the options for anyone that is new to Protonwar, so that you can customise the game a bit more for an enjoyable experience!


[b]MOVEMENT MODES[/b]

First off, when you start the game you get a choice between, "[i]Teleport Only[/i]" movement, "[i]Advanced[/i]" movement, or "[i]Seated[/i]" mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23544121/e512666e3023d46c51571e49b1e29ac204d4445b.jpg[/img]

[b]Teleport only[/b]: This will lock the character into a teleport only type movement mode, this is recommended for absolute vr beginners, or people that suffer from motion sickness in vr.

[b]Advanced[/b]: This mode has full locomotion using your trackpad or joysticks on your motion controllers. This mode is similar to Onward or Pavlov. This is my personal favorite!

[b]Seated[/b]: Seated is designed to be played with either a mouse and keyboard, or a control pad while seated at a desk, i will not cover the specific options for this mode as i do not recommend it, but it can be fun to play around in :)


You can select the menu options by pointing your controller at the option and pressing on your triggers.





[b]CONTROLLER SETTINGS[/b]

To adjust how the controllers are mapped you can select "[i]Settings[/i]" then "[i]Input Presets[/i]" then "[i]Config Motion[/i]" to adjust your VR controllers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23544121/4a153ef80f43bf42f6e205ebcebe3b69fb08d42d.jpg[/img]

Trackpad: Default movement using the trackpad or joystick. To turn your character around in game you have to physically turn your body. This is the recommended setting as it is more comfortable.

TrackpadLefty: Default movement mode for a left handed person

TrackpadWithTurn: This mode will let you rotate your character around by using left / right on the joystick. This mode is reserved for the truly hardcore vr players as it can cause motion sickness.

TrackpadWithTurnLefty: Same as above, but for left handed.





[b]EXTRA CONTROL SETTINGS[/b]

We can now also adjust some of the more advanced options about the movement, this can be done by selecting "[i]Settings[/i]" then "[i]Input Extra[/i]"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23544121/df6c0c272ada7da85ee8c91fdb86c1c4b96a2b7f.jpg[/img]


[b]Alt Move Enabled[/b]: This is an extra mode that some people might have fun with, this mode relies on you pressing on your "[i]Grip[/i]" button, then doing an action. We can choose between "[i]Arm Swing[/i]", where your character will move forward based on you swinging your arms. Or "[i]Player Relative[/i]" which is when you hold the grip button down, and point your controller in the direction you wish to move.

[b]Slide Control Rotation[/b]: With this option enabled your movement direction is relative to the rotation of your motion controller, This can be a bit flaky at times, so it is off by default. However some players that have come from games like Onward/Pavlov might like this option.

[b]Slide Move Enabled[/b]: Disable this if you wish to completely disable movement from the trackpad/joysticks. Only recommended if you are using the "Alt Move" options.

[b]Slide Strafe Enabled[/b]: Disable this if you wish to disable Strafe movement that happens by pressing left/right on your trackpad/joystick.

[b]Jump Enabled[/b]: Disabling this option will disable character jumping.






[b]EXTRA FOR INDEX CONTROLLERS[/b]

The game has been tested on an Index and works as expected. The only real issue here is the default grip settings on the index seem to be causing jumping issues for a few people as the grip on the index uses a new touch sensitivity feature.
I have found a tip on reddit on how to reconfigure your index controllers in a way that i believe will improve the experience on the index for this game, and any game that uses a grip, that came out before the Index. (Or games designed for Oculus seem to be similar)
https://www.reddit.com/r/ValveIndex/comments/dxuj00/tips_for_index_controller_grip_set_up_for_oculus/

This option should fix up that issue for any Index users.


I hope that you found this small guide useful and that it will improve the experience for you all!


Cheers :-)
-Gozu

notes.title: Oculus Rift, SteamVR Performance issues?
notes.content:
Hello future fraggers,

It has come to my attention that there are some potential performance issues if running SteamVR apps while using an Oculus with the current version of SteamVR.

This is not something that should affect you in Protonwar due to it using the oculus SDK, but if you are attempting to run the game using the SteamVR mode and having issues please check the current options in SteamVR and it may help clear up any bad performance.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/bcfd134321e2dee919127cff11190b47790c6173.jpg[/img]

There is a good resource over on Reddit for SteamVR use with the oculus, located over here:
[url]https://www.reddit.com/r/oculus/wiki/steamvr[/url]


This is probably not affecting anyone, but i just wanted to share the knowledge, incase there where any users struggling with performance with Protonwar, or any other games on the Rift.


Cheers, and Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Price drop incoming!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

First off, a big thank you to anyone that has supported Protonwar through early access and from release.

Time has come to drop the price slightly, as i feel that it is only fair.


It was a great pleasure to make the game, and to learn about what could be possible in a VR Arena FPS.

The VR market has grown and changed tremendously over the last 5 years, and looks like it will continue to grow. It really is here to stay now!
I cannot wait to see what Oculus and other vendors have up their sleeves next. My dreams of high PPI screens and amazing graphics are so close now. Once they can solve motion sickness, and eye focus issues we will literally never have to leave VR! ;)


Once approved from Valve the price will drop to $9.99 usd for now and the foreseeable future.
Commercial licensing prices will also drop.

GG,
-Gozu

notes.title: Protonwar - 0.6 - Melee Combat Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/ad3f426ba3617346d77e91a73db070356368ad5e.png[/img]

[i]ps. Wrist Straps.[/i]
I highly recommend that you now use the wrist straps that come with your vr controllers, if not already!
I also recommend turning on show gaurdian for oculus, and show chaperone for steamvr if that is what you use! :-)


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/1c25aab407606b979b838b1caf0caae81e23fa94.png[/img]


[b]MELEE COMBAT![/b]
Im so excited to announce that Melee combat is finally here!
Each character gets 1 selectable Melee weapon, which can be choosen from the character menu.
Each weapon comes with unique characteristics.

Use your Melee weapon to block projectiles, or to damage your enemy, or simply just humiliate your enemy by attacking their ragdoll after you take them out ;-)

The damage is dependant on the velocity of the hit, and the shape / size of the weapon you have chosen.
In [b]vr[/b] you get 1-1 sword movement as you would in real life, with proper IK so you see exactly where your enemy's sword is.
In [i]non vr[/i] there is 6 differnt attack types, Up left, Mid left, Down left, Up right, Mid right, Down right.

Because its really really fun, there is also a mutator for Melee only mode!



[b]NEW GAME MODE! - HUNT THE FLAG[/b]
There is now a new game mode called "Hunt the Flag" (rabbit)...
It is a Free for All game mode, at the start of the match a flag is spawned at a random location on the map.
Players get 1 point for a kill, as normal, but get 2 points for a kill when holding the flag.
While holding the flag players get given a point every 3 seconds.

Person with the most points at the end of the round wins.
[i]This will now be the default mode on the official servers.[/i]

There is also a new flag, which gets holstered onto the character when carrying. 8-)


[b]WEAPON WHEEL, NO MORE...[/b]
The weapon wheel has been removed, as it was the #1 complaint.
On the vive you now can select your weapon up and down using the up and down on your primary hand track pad.

On the rift it is a bit differnt, The bottom button on your primary hand switches to previous weapon, the bottom button on your sec hand switches to next weapon.
The top button is still used for climb / special jump. This due to the grip being fine for climbing, but very clumsy for the jump.




[b]Lots more!...[/b]
Massive optimization passes on Overgrown, and Swamp Lands, along with some layout / item placement adjustments on Swamp Lands.
Lots of small issues have also been resolved, too many to list...


Please remember to use your wrist straps while playing, it will save the surprise of the controller flying out of your hand! (like mine! ;)

Have fun!!!
-Gozu

Hi Guys! ːsteamhappyː

I wanted to make this post here just to go over some things that will be coming up in the next patch.
It has involved quite a lot of work and testing so the patch will not be out till late next week. But it will be worth the wait!



First off, i have been working on some of the levels and have changed the layout on Abyss to make it flow a bit better.
I have also started rebuild Castle, however that will take some time....

[i]Changes to Abyss;[/i]
 - Sniper area is now larger, and more open
 - Red Armor area is now smaller
 - Blue / Teleport room has been opened up a bit with less columns

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/7a22b0a198ccf0379942b2e5e65e7dbb6b413d8d.png[/img]


[b]Secondly[/b], I have been doing considerable work on the AI to improve bot play.
This has involved changing the way that i deal with the behavior, and in the process i have fixed up quite a lot of bugs. You should start to see the bots retreat more, and deal with their weapon ammo a bit better! :)

[b]Third big one,[/b]
I have decided to remove the reload clips system, and go back to the way it used to be.
I initially added it to slow the game play down a bit, but i think it's not right with it, it's not what i set out to do with the game, so it's back to being single clip like Quake/UT.

[b]Fourth biggy;[/b]
I have been spending considerable time balancing the weapons better, and tweaking the locational damage. I still have quite a bit to do here, which is why there will not be a patch till next week, it's something that needs to be done right.

Smaller things will be, lots of optimization to things like particle effects, HUD tweaks, and i have fixed a bunch of bugs that i discovered in CTF and DOM modes.


The patch should be out about mid/late next week, i'm looking forward to spending a bunch of time playing it with the new balances!

After this i will be focusing on some of the levels, particularly Castle, Aerowalk, Hazardous and Trinity (all the ones i consider far from finished).
I will also be investigating more changes to the networking / hosting situation and matchmaking solutions.


Thanks for the interest!
Have a great weekend gaming! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Protonwar - 0.32 - Location Based Hit Damage
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/1b8218d6ebff32786fab6122ba963bc2bc743f01.png[/img]

This week brings a couple of more changes to the core gameplay based on some of the community feedback (keep it coming!)

The damage that your weapon deals is now based on where you hit the character, so those headshots are so much more important now!

[i]Here is the current setup;[/i]
Headshot - 200%
Arms and Legs - 50%
Body - 100%

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/1d257d876e8ddac4f70253c5b5ec76b8a08cab94.png[/img]

This means that, for example a headshot will do 2x the normal damage, with any weapon, and the further away from the center of the head you get, the damage decreases from there.

We have also bumped up the walk speed a little bit, and spent more time tweaking the advanced jump mechanic to make it a bit easier on the arms, while trying to keep it in a way that will still require skill to use well :)

You can use the advanced jump while on the ground, or while in the air, it will work until you get about 4 meters off the ground.


There is also a bunch of critical crash fixes for servers, that were noticed during testing.


The feedback from the community has been really great recently, and it is very appreciated!

Steady up!
-Gozu

notes.title: Protonwar - 0.21 HF1 - Small fixes everywhere for everyone
notes.content:
I'll save on the large notes for this patch as it includes lots of backend fixes and bug fixes for all modes.


You now spawn into the match, it will ask you to press fire to start. One of the players just has to pull the trigger, then the match will countdown and start.

Main user facing fixes are improved HUD for all VR modes with better notifications, including timer notices for 5 minutes remaining, 3 minutes remaining, and 1 minute remaining with announcer calls.

I have also now linked up the Trackpad with yaw controller schemes so that you can adjust the speed. This can be set from the input tab under "Trackpad / Gamepad / Joystick" section, These sensitivities apply to all those controllers.
These settings will have been reset in your save. (just the sensitivity ones)

I have also modified the "Speed Boots" mutator. This now will let you walk at 2x speed, incase you feel like you want a faster speed ;)

I have also dropped the default graphics settings, and the "medium vr" settings to be a bit lower.


[b]NOTE:[/b] i really do not personally recommend playing with faster walking speed, or playing with yaw, yaw is particularly bad.
this control mode will likely cause motion sickness for a lot of people, if you get any frame rate stutters when turning, it can be a bit rough, so be warned!

In order to have a motion sickness free experience i recommend,
playing with the graphics settings set from the medium button
playing with full 360 tracking
playing without yaw (default settings should be fine for *most*)

and if it's still causing issues there are teleport only modes that should be good.



Enjoy!
-Gozu

notes.title: Protonwar - 0.20HF4 - VR Arcade Features!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/d22225cf2a81b287e41b72d2a59a62633cb77211.png[/img]

Over the last week i have addressed some of the feedback from various VR arcades, and included some features in this patch to make their job a little easier.

First feature is an [b]"offline"[/b] start up mode, which by-passes the Steam networking. This will reduce connection issues caused by an inconsistent internet connection, and lets you play local, or LAN matches un-interrupted by steam networking.
To start this mode, right click on the Protonwar menu item in Steam, and select "Launch Protonwar Offline...."

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/1216f57b802c979fa6a3e5e17d0b659a0c37a9d0.png[/img]

I recommend this for Arcades that are getting disconnection issues.



The [b]"Quick Match"[/b] menu has been improved to make hosting and joining games quicker.
[i]it now features; [/i]
A "Single Player" button, for solo bot matches
A "Multiplayer" button for LAN or Internet multiplayer games (eg; host a match)
A "Quick Join" button, which will quickly search the LAN, or Internet and join the first server it finds!

There is also a "LAN" checkbox, checked by default. This makes the server only visible on the local network.

This should help streamline the process of arcades getting into games quicker with less staff intervention.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/b2869f08e10283fdce047f26cb8b5cd2e71feec0.jpg[/img]


[i]Not related to arcades,[/i]
I have now added an experimental movement mode, which lets you tweak the walking speed of the trackpad movement by tilting the controller.
This is marked as "experimental" and is off by default.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/788dfe186447f5152d6bababd958d7d1e530d36e.png[/img]


I hope that you enjoy these changes, they should make everyones lives easier!

Thanks for supporting early access!
Have fun!


:)
-Gozu, out.

notes.title: Protonwar - 0.19.1 - Big fixes and 2017 plans!
notes.content:
Protonwar - 0.19.1 - Big fixes and 2017 plans!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/fa581ea6c4f07ebc7057c51f2c60366455b2af19.png[/img]

[b]Massive changes to the way ammo works![/b] 
Weapons now reload, this happens automatically at the end of the clip and forces you to take your finger off the trigger, there are no animations currently, but the lights will flash and you will get the idea.
At this stage I do not plan to add weapon interaction for reloading, if anything it would just stay a quick button, clip drops out and auto replaces...
This is primarily to slow gameplay down, and make each bullet more important.
You may of noticed in the last few patches the TTK is now lower, this is all an effort to make enemies feel less like bullet sponges and to encourage more meaningful encounters.

Each weapon has clips and ammo per clip.
example:
[i]Assault Rifle - 30 Ammo per clip, Start 3 clips, max 6 clips
	      - Time between shots 0.1 seconds
              - Reload time 1.5 seconds[/i]

Some weapons such as the Reaper, have large clips, and you can only carry 2 max. This is a fasssssst energy weapon.

I have also set much stricter limits on the max ammo for each weapon, particularly the more powerful weapons to make them more meaningful.

These values will no doubt, require a bit of tweaking and massaging to feel right, but from the testing i feel that it improves the gameplay by adding a little bit of complexity, while still keeping it simple.



[b]New Mutators added:[/b]
"Speed" mutator, increases the walk speed by 1.25x (any more makes you feel pretty ill in VR...)
No Ammo Pickups
No Weapon Pickups
No Health Pickups
Health Regen (50 health on spawn, Max 50 health, health regenerates, no health or armor pickups)
[i](no ammo and no health is quite cool combined)[/i]


[b]Misc Stuff!:[/b]
New trace effects for the shotgun and the assault that are much more "3d" for vr...
Improved end of match notification / scoreboard in vr
Fixed jump boots mutator for vr character
AI tweaks for finding pickups
AI ammo handling tweaks
Fixed strafing animations
Fixed bug with scope's in Non VR
HUD tweaks for Non VR and moved weapon bar to bottom of screen
Fixed some demo playback bugs, i will be shortly putting this stuff into the menu (its not a high priority)


[b]Plans for 2017 thus far:[/b]

I will keep this brief for now, as things change ;) haha!
I have been working on a new game mode that will be called 'Heroes', it will let you select a character at the start of a round, each differnt character will have a differnt load out, these will include new weapons. It will be an objective / team based game mode.
This will be also expanded and modified specifically to make it work great for VR Arcades, quick pick up and play games, so i guess this will be a smaller trimmed down dm version of heroes...

There will be new "super weapons" added
More levels
Better demo record and playback integration

Have fun!


:)

-Gozu, out.

notes.title: Protonwar - 0.17 MSAA + NEW LEVEL + IMPROVED TRACKPAD and much much more!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/580f8e8f555d6356fd1204e5dd32dabde638a09a.png[/img]

(Slightly technical notes, sorry :)

MSAA NOTES:
With this patch i have moved to the new forward render path in the engine. This means a few things, the best being that we can now use MSAA in VR, so the image looks much cleaner!
Set the AA settings in the settings menu accordingly, I recommend Medium, if you want a cleaner image than that you get better quality/perf by then increasing the resolution scale.
I recommend with AA enabled that you keep to the default 140% screen percentage in VR on low/mid end, 160 is good for high end.

There is a trade off that comes with this though, this trade off is that lighting is not as realistic. And i have had to remove some of the special effects.
I think this trade off is 100% worth it though as the game is just looking fantastic now!
I have had to re-do all the lighting, so there will be room for improvement here as i am still 100% learning how to best light a scene in the new renderer.

This is also why the patch is so large! Lightmaps/Textures take lots of space! :D


NEW LEVEL!
This patch also includes a new map DM-Overgrown. Similar in concept to DM-Ruins, but with nicer graphics ;). It is a nice outdoor level, and the first to use foliage :)
The foliage is COSTLY though, in VR when there is lots going on.
I've spent a large amount of time optimizing it, but i think that is about as far as i can go for now while keeping it dense enough :)



Other Fixes and Improvements:
Lots of small tweaks here and everywhere in the maps
All backend movement code rewritten / optimized
Fixed strafing on Trackpad movement
**Trackpad forward movement speed is now also controlled using the distance of the controller relative to the player (yes, like Onward)**
Increased Rocket jump height
Improved Rocket/Grenade explosions
Squashed more bugs!



I hope that you enjoy these changes as much as we do! Please remember this is still early access, and expect constant improvements and bug fixes.


In other news, Protonwar was recently at Paris games week, in a booth with Lenovo and ESL. The game was very well received and people were queuing up to play!
With VR's constant growth in popularity i think FPS games in VR have a very bright future that i cannot wait to be part of!
This week Protonwar will be at Dreamhack Sweden!



Thanks for the support!
-Gozu, out.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Protonwar 0.14
notes.content:
This patch brings in a new mutator, which I'm hoping the casual audience will enjoy, and some well-needed features. Along with a bunch of nice fixes.

Work has been going on for a new map called DM-Ruins (currently) Which is designed as a tactical / cover shooter map, featuring lots of cover, 2 elevators, and an epic health right in the center of the map. This map should be in the next patch, after a bit more playtesting. Sooooooooon ;)

Energy gauge moved to the top part of the left hand, like you are looking at a watch :-)
Teleport improved, now behaves better and looks better. Still, more work to do on the visual side of this...
Burst rate decreased for AI fire
Increased time between spawns
Ragdolls now fade out (also behave amazingly in the low grav mutator)
Fixed decal spawn bugs on certain meshes
Decreased "Arm Swing" smoothing slightly
Lowered splash damage radius on Photon gun
Decreased / Removed the slight recoil that the Reaper had
Fixed non-vr offsets for instagib weapon and time dilation gun


Also i have created a fancy pants tutorial video on the movement for the HTC Vive. This can be found up front in the videos section of the store page.

GLHF!

notes.content:
It's beautiful. It's like liquid it... slides all over everything. Comes up in waves. And they just kept hitting him, wave after wave.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

"Project Holo" renamed to simply "Horde Mode"
Horde Mode added for Non VR and Seated VR!!! These modes will still require a bit more work for non vr or seated players as they are balanced for the standing mode. This will happen shortly :-)
Third Person mutator added! (only supported in Non VR or Seated VR currently)
AI path finding tweaked
AI low ammo behaviour re-written/fixed
Fixes for IK aim rotation being off
Menu optimizations
Particle systems optimizations


[b]VR Movement Modes for Standing VR Explained[/b]

Please bare with us, as these are most certainly a work in progress. We will be starting to focus a bit more heavily on Locomotion and specific room scale vr tweaks over the next few weeks.
These options have been tweaked a little bit, to offer two options, under the menu you have an option, enabled by default "VR Movement From Marker"

This will act like so:
You press the trigger to "engage" the movement. A red dot shows up on the screen.
The movement is relative to this dot.
Release the trigger to reset this. (tip: don't hold it down all the time)

If this is disabled it will behave like so:
Press trigger to engage move
Movement will go towards to controller, relative to its location from the camera (this is the old system)

Choose whichever mode you feel more comfortable with.


[b]Onwards and upwards[/b]
Over the next coming weeks, here is a teaser of some of the things we have planned:

notes.title: Patch 0.11 HF2! - For the Rift
notes.content:
Hi Team,

Here is a patch to address all of the issues with the Oculus Rift. (height issues and menu issues)

If the camera pitch is something that you do not like, please try out the alternate mouse mode by pressing "M"
[i]Please NOTE: HOLO servers are for VIVE only.[/i]

Here are some helpful tips to help you out if you are having issues with the Rift:

[b]How to get into the game:[/b]
Start SteamVR
Wait for SteamVR to load and confirm all devices are detected
If using a Control Pad turn this on now
Open your Steam Library and browse to Protonwar
Ensure that the play icon indicates "Play in VR"
If it does not check your SteamVR setup
Click on Play In VR and put your headset on
Protonwar will then ask you if you want to play standing or in seated mode, as a Rift user, select “Seated” mode.

[b]Tips:[/b]
To select menu items simply look at the button and press Space Bar or Right Trigger on your control pad
To get back to the menu once in game press escape. and press Q to go to the main menu
 If your movements are not tracked correctly please calibrate your sensor via the oculus home application. See https://support.oculus.com/help/oculus/449651231906396/ for help
If you move your sensor you may need to calibrate again

*If you are uncomfortable with camera movement, try the alternate mouse mode by pressing the “M” key*


Cheers.

notes.title: New default movement mechanics for Vive
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

With some feedback i have changed the default movement on the Vive to be based off the controller position relative to where it was located when you first clicked the trigger. (as seen in Hover Junkers)

Hopefully it's a bit better.

Here is a video demonstrating the new movement.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i_Et3Vq0HQA


I understand that orientation is still an issue, particularly when you are moving around and rotating around a lot, and have vive cables getting in the way! I'm still thinking about how we can make this better.  It's my experience that just no one knows how to deal with this part very well yet, so it may take some experimentation. I think this is why we are seeing a lot of wave based shooters on the market, where you just don't have to move. Or games where you only have to walk in one direction most of the time.

Personally i find that having the chaperone bounds being drawn really helps in this situation. I have quite a small play space though so that's all probably subjective.



Thanks!

notes.title: Protonwar - Patch 0.11
notes.content:
[h1] Protonwar - Patch 0.11 [/h1]

Hi Team!

This patch is quite significant in a few ways so i decided to post up a small write up here.

[b] First big thing i would like to announce is the addition of Gamepad support.[/b]
This will function in the Seated VR, and Non VR game modes! :-)
This means, just to make things easier that i have updated the seated vr menu navigation to be based off the direction you are looking at. Simply move your head around to move the cursor, then press "Space bar" or "Right Trigger" to select an item in the menu. If you are having issues with the cursor being off center, please rotate your character using the right stick (this will be resolved shortly)
In the last patch i also added a fancy new cursor, that animates when you click on things, just to improve usability in the UI.

[b] Second big thing i would like to announce is the inclusion of a new teleportation system.[/b]
The teleport function in Standing VR now uses a parabolic arc. This means that you can now teleport up onto ledges, or down onto ledges.
Use the teleport the same way you used to "Left Facepad Up" on the vive motion controller. If you are trying to get to an area where you cannot reach, the teleport effects will display as red. If you are good to GO, they will display as blue, release the trigger and zap to your new location!
Dont forget that this will use up some of your energy stats, so keep an eye on this and reserve it for pulling off that quick escape, or grabbing the epic health before your enemy does!

[b]Third thing is the inclusion of a new announcer![/b]
There is now many more voice announcer calls setup, with a nice meaty sounding announcer voice to pump you up during the fight.

[b]Fourth thing[/b]
There are some small HUD changes in relation to movement with the HUD. If you stand still not moving the HUD will no longer rotate with you, once you start to move forward it will snap to your rotation.
This is just the very very very beginning stages of the changes that i will be making to hud, to make it a bit cooler, and hopefully help with orientation. Lets see how this small change pans out for starters.

In the background, we have been doing some optimizations around network performance, and improved it a bit in the previous patch. I will be keeping an eye on this but at the moment the network performance should be very good, so gear up your mates, and give it a shot.
We will soon have the Steam friends list integrated directly into the game, just to make this a bit easier for you.


[b]Please note[/b] that the new gamepad support, does not allow you to play against motion control users, they are separate game modes.
How ever we do plan in the very near future to branch out the holo mode to the seated vr and non vr users.
Also keep in mind that this is initial support, that will be tweaked a bit in the future. Things such as slowing the character down while scoping, toggling walk run etc, are not implemented as of yet.

One more thing, if you are getting a crash to desktop from the game, we have detailed instructions over here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/461410/discussions/3/366298942100280873/
about what you can do before submitting a bug report to assit with speedy resolution.
If you get a crash first try restart the game, see if it happens again, then try restart your PC, and ensure that your video drivers / windows updates are up to date before submitting a report.


Here is an image of the currently assigned gamepad controls, they are currently not editable from the menu, but this is another feature that will be added very shortly.

New Gamepad Controls:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/e7bf210e9442baae32eda230c81ef0a4990be39e.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch notes 12/07/2016 and Project Holo CO-OP notes
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

I would just like to take a brief moment to discuss some various things, such as the Project Holo gameplay mode that i have included.

It is in quite early stages and much more experimental than the multiplayer sections of the game (The AI is not the best!), but this mode is here as a CO-OP online multiplayer wave shooter mode.
There are some bugs if played in co-op where the character that is not the host does not see some of the UI notifications, but all of the actual gameplay stuff works sweet as in co-op. Hiding behind cover, ducking, gunplay, teleporting, all off the good stuff, you can even start a match using any of the supplied mutators.

IK / Character Animations:
No one has asked about this but i figured it was worth mentioning, and discussing how this is implemented currently.
Your head movement is tracked, and this movement is replicated across the network. Its pretty creepy having people look at you! almost surreal.
The hand IK is something that gets generated from just your gun holding hand, and to some degree it is tied to the animations.
It is done this way to avoid having everyone running around with their arms flailing about the place. This may change in the future, but the current approach is a little more serious, geared towards making the character animations with the gun better.

That brings up a few other points. The animations are all mo-capped from a trained professional with weapon handling experience, there will be more added, including taunting. There are some issues with left hand placement, and this will be fixed with IK in the future.

We are tracking and replicating all of the head data, and left and right hand.




I have just this minute finished uploading the latest patch after some rigorous testing, not much content, as it has been mainly bug fixing/testing to clean up the UI bugs.

Patch Notes:
Non VR ingame menu issues fixed.
Non VR, movement input config added (axis bindings)
VR menu interaction has now changed, this should be much more reliable for people, and resolved for those that had issues clicking on items.
VR default options, increased screen resolution to 140% for default.
Small UI tweaks here and there.
General stability improvements; Potentially some more caused by various HW configs, these are generally engine bugs that are being worked on.


Thanks again for the positive responses, and the discussion around features that you want to see.

Its truly AWESOME to see you guys enjoying it so far.

Please feel free to get out there and share your experiences on places such as Reddit or Twitter or what not. I will have some review copies going out today and hopefully start generating some more interest to get more players on board!

Till next time!

notes.title: Menu issues and Crash fixes, patched!
notes.content:
[b]Hello again![/b]

Thanks to some helpfull people we have tracked down what i beleive was causing the cursor issues some people are having in the first menu screen.
I have now updated the game to handle the menu input quite differntly and this should resolve this issue. If this does indeed resolve it for you, can you please leave feedback so that we know it is resolved.
Thanks.


If you are using an [b]HTC Vive[/b], please ensure that you have your motion controls turned on when trying to use the menu.

If you are using an [b]Oculus Rift[/b] you can now navigate the menu using either the mouse, or your head. If you do not see the mouse cursor, wiggle your mouse around and it should show up!

If you have issues clicking on something, make sure you are focused on it.

I have also made some fixes that should resolve alot of the crashes that people where having.


[b]Things that may cause crashes that you can try:[/b]
Older video drivers, have you tried the newest?
Video cards getting too HOT, try lowering graphics options.
Video capture software such as Geforce Experience/Shadow Play, disable any such software if it is causing an issue.
Beta SteamVR clients, i really do not recommend running the beta software here, as it can cause all sorts of unforseen technical issues.
Any background software that steals window focus, This really should not be an issue, but it is worth mentioning, some times software can steal window focus, and this can crash direct-x. VERY rare, but it can happen.

There may still be a crash everynow and then it is a complicated system and we are working around the clock to get everything sorted!


[b]NOTE ON HARDWARE SUPPORT![/b]
There where some crashes reported by people that where running pre-retail vive or rift units. These issues should be resolved BUT i will only be supporting RETAIL units. If you have a pre-retail rift or vive and are getting crashes, this may be the cause. The reason for this is purely because we do not have sources to test these sorts of crashes on.


[b]GENERAL NOTES:[/b]
If you find text hard to read in the menu, please try clicking "SET RECOMMENDED SETTINGS" in the video settings screen, this should help out. Alternativly if you have fast hardware you can use the slider to adjust the resolution percentage, this is what everyone refers to as super sampling.
Settings we find work good:
GTX 770 - min specs, 130%, shadows low, postprocessing low, aa low.
GTX 1080 - super duper specs, 170%, high settings, AA is probally worth keeping at low.


[b]NOTES ABOUT CHARACTER MOVEMENT ON VIVE[/b]
We have been testing out some changes with community help and feedback and hope to have differnt options for controls in the future.
There will be at least 2 differnt locomotion control schemes for the Vive controls that will be selectable via the menu.
These changes will come within good time and we will start testing these more rigorously starting next week!


[b]NOTES ABOUT CONTENT / LEVELS[/b]
We will be added new content such as levels, and graphical themes for levels during the course of early access. Plans are currently to have a group of set themes, and to have multiple differnt levels using those themes.
If you wish to vote / suggest themes that you would like to see please head over to the community page and voice your opinions! :D


I have also made the following fixes and changes today, some features requested by the community:

[b]Things that may cause crashes that you can try:[/b]
Older video drivers, have you tried the newest?
Video cards getting too HOT, try lowering graphics options.
Video capture software such as Geforce Experience/Shadow Play, disable any such software if it is causing an issue.
Beta SteamVR clients, i really do not recommend running the beta software here, as it can cause all sorts of unforseen technical issues.
Any background software that steals window focus, This really should not be an issue, but it is worth mentioning, some times software can steal window focus, and this can crash direct-x. VERY rare, but it can happen.

notes.title: SteamVR Room Scale Modes Announcement!
notes.content:
HI GUYS!

Exciting news, I'm getting HYPED and cannot wait to play these modes with some of you!

Now for Standing VR we have two different game modes (more to come very soon)

-Deathmatch (play with bots, or play online)
-Project Holo (horde like AI co-op, play by yourself or with a friend, this mode is in very early stages)

I have been spending quite a lot of time getting this good, and i think it is ready enough now for people to start playing as early access.

I have created a unique movement system that i feel works very well and is suited for this style game.


The systems this includes:

Movement within roomscale is translated to very small movements in game.

Hold down "Left Trigger" for move mode, aim both controllers in the direction you wish to go. This works by getting a direction from both controllers, and working out which way to go, the further away the controllers get from each other, the slower you will go. This forces the player to actually turn around if they wish to turn around, and makes movement much more involved and fun. You have a fine control over your speed with the distance you are holding the controllers away from your body.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23544121/7b6b318f5b701be7a10c2bfd33b83136cb49a8e8.png[/img]

Crouching works like it would in real-life. Project Holo maps will be designed with lots of options for cover.

and finally, the Dash. Aim the dash like a teleport, and receive a quick boost in this direction. (very very quick)
This boost uses up a new energy scale. You spawn with 100 energy, each dash uses 25 energy, and the energy is regenerated at the rate of 1 unit per second, so use your dash wisely.


I hope i have been able to explain this in a way that you can understand, i will try and get a video up shortly. In the meantime here is a picture that might make more sense.

notes.title: Character Selection! and standing vr game mode progress!
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

A bit out of the blue here as i had not planned to do this until a later date, but, anyway! ;)

I have now implemented runtime character model changing, this means you can now select from the Female and Male SciFi Soldier in the menu!

You can see a new shiney image of the models here:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=704491107] ART! [/url]


Over the past few weeks i have been mainly working on finalising a lot of things, and tweaking the UI, and of course, squashing those bugs!
I also upgraded to the shiney new version of UE 4.12.2.




I also have had some time to do a bit more work on a mode that i have called [b]"Project Holo"[/b].


Project Holo is a standing, room scale VR experience for the HTC Vive, it is a checkpoint based cover shooter mode against AI. (similar to Raw Data).
It's quite early days, (no character IK, multiplayer works, but will be wonky, only 1 map setup to use it) But, it is something that i am pretty excited to continue to work on once we can get Early Access out! :-)
At the current moment, it can be supported in any map with a little bit of work, but i would prefer to start making some custom maps for it.


[b]How does "Project Holo" play? [/b]

You spawn at a start location with your default weapons, each map has 4 main combat area's. Inside these areas there are weapon spawns, and ammo spawns (weapons get better on later area's etc), health and armor spawns.
Each area will spawn waves of AI soldiers once you reach it, getting increasingly stronger as your progress through the waves. Once the waves are complete, the area gets marked as complete and you can move along to the next area which will contain better weapons and items, and harder enemies! :)

All very WIP at the moment, but all the base fundamentals are in and going. Currently this is using weapons from the base game, but some of these, particularly the more powerful weapons (eg sniper rifle) will need to be tweaked specifically for the mode :)

That is all for now, lots of progress behind the scenes, but still lots to do!

Thanks guys! <3 :)
GLHF!
